actions.add_transaction.description: Adds one transaction to an account.
actions.add_transaction.props.amount.des: Decimal amount in currency units; negative = expense, e.g. -12.50
actions.add_transaction.props.imported_i: Optional unique key; a repeat with the same key is skipped instead of added twice
actions.add_transaction.props.payee_name: Who was paid or who paid
actions.delete_transaction.description: Deletes a transaction (and its splits). This cannot be undone from the flow.
actions.find_payees.description: Finds payees whose name contains the search text (all payees when empty).
actions.find_payees.props.search.descrip: Part of the payee name, e.g. "kroger". Leave empty to list all payees.
actions.find_transactions.description: Finds transactions in a date range, optionally filtered by account, payee, category, amount or text.
actions.find_transactions.props.account_: Only this account. Leave empty for all accounts.
actions.find_transactions.props.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Leave empty for no end.
actions.find_transactions.props.payee_id: Only this payee (ID from Find Payees)
actions.find_transactions.props.search.d: Matched against notes, payee name and imported payee
actions.get_accounts.description: Gets every account in the budget (open and closed).
actions.get_budget.description: Gets the budget for one month: totals plus budgeted, spent and balance per category (amounts in cents).
actions.get_budget.props.month.descripti: The month of the budget you want to get
actions.get_budget.props.year.descriptio: The year of the budget you want to get
actions.get_budget_month.description: Gets the budget for one month (YYYY-MM).
actions.get_categories.description: Gets every budget category as a flat list.
actions.import_transaction.description: Adds one transaction to an account. Actual runs your rules on it and skips it when the Imported ID was already imported.
actions.import_transaction.props.account: The account to add the transaction to
Amount in your currency, e.g. -12.50. Negative = money out (expense), positive = money in.
actions.import_transaction.props.date.de: The day the transaction took place. A plain date (YYYY-MM-DD) is kept as is; a date with a time is stored on its UTC day.
actions.import_transaction.props.importe: Unique ID from your bank or source system. A second import with the same ID is skipped.
Raw description from the bank, kept as the original value
actions.import_transaction.props.payee_n: Name of the payee. Actual reuses a payee with this name or creates it.
actions.import_transaction.props.transfe: Legacy field, ignored by Actual on import. To record a transfer, use the other account's transfer payee as the Payee Name.
actions.import_transactions.description: Imports many transactions into one account. Amounts are integer cents (-1250 = -12.50). Rows whose imported_id was already imported are skipped.
actions.import_transactions.props.accoun: ID of the account to import into (from Get Accounts / List Accounts)
actions.import_transactions.props.transa: JSON array of transactions. date = YYYY-MM-DD, amount = integer cents as a number or string like "-1250" (negative = expense, -1250 = -12.50). Optional: payee_name, category (ID), notes, imported_id, cleared.
actions.list_accounts.description: Lists accounts with their current balance.
actions.list_categories.description: Lists category groups with their categories.
actions.run_bank_sync.description: Pulls new transactions from the bank for one linked account, or for all linked accounts.
actions.run_bank_sync.props.account_id.d: Linked account to sync. Leave empty to sync all linked accounts.
actions.set_budget_amount.description: Sets how much is budgeted for a category in a month (replaces the current amount).
actions.set_budget_amount.props.amount.d: Budgeted amount in currency units, e.g. 250
actions.update_transaction.description: Changes fields of an existing transaction. Empty fields are left unchanged.
actions.update_transaction.props.cleared: Leave empty to keep the current value
auth.description:
Connect to your self-hosted Actual Budget server (version 26.x recommended; the piece uses the official @actual-app/api 26.10.0, and very old servers may refuse it).
1. **Server URL**: the address you open Actual on, e.g. `https://actual.example.com` or `http://localhost:5006`.
2. **Password**: the server password you log in to Actual with.
3. **Sync ID**: in Actual open **Settings → Show advanced settings → Sync ID**.
4. **End-to-end encryption password**: only if you turned on end-to-end encryption for this budget.
auth.props.encryption_password.descripti: Only if end-to-end encryption is turned on for this budget
auth.props.password.description: The password you use to log in to the server
auth.props.server_url.description: The URL of your Actual server, e.g. https://actual.example.com
auth.props.sync_id.description: Settings → Show advanced settings → Sync ID
description: Open-source personal finance app with envelope budgeting (self-hosted)
triggers.new_transaction.description: Triggers when a transaction dated within the last 7 days (or later) is added to an account. Split transactions trigger once, with their splits.
triggers.new_transaction.props.account_i: Only watch this account. Leave empty to watch all accounts.
